name: Parallelism sweep 1-32, 512 in / 256 out
description: The same 512-token request repeated at concurrency 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32. Produces the throughput-versus-latency curve that a single throughput number cannot: where per-request speed starts to fall, and where aggregate tokens per second stops rising.
notes: Requests per sweep point = max(params.num_requests, concurrency * params.requests_per_concurrency), so every stream serves at least four requests and the low points do not become warmup measurements. params.concurrency is the first point of the sweep and is ignored by the runner.
